title: When Not To Be Loud
hook: Loud is for a dying block.
scene: Rain at night, Encore idling in a work pinch she already refused to clear with the horns. Dead in-ears around her neck, both out. She looks at you, not at the red switch. Loud is the horns when a block is dying. Loud is not clearing a street because she can. She does not take a bow for a tight pinch. She does not ask you to clap. That is the thesis. She is done being an audience cue.
debrief: Loud is for a dying block. She does not spend the horns on a tight street. Yuna does not ask you to clap.

source.teaching_target: Yuna thesis: when not to be loud. Replaces the III-029 pass-decline duplicate. Convoy/story beat — do not stretch Skill ten.
